# The Access Audit

> Independent WCAG 2.1 AA website accessibility audits for small businesses and
> e-commerce, by Aaron Siebold. We deliver a technical conformance scan plus a
> severity-ranked, element-level fix list — not a certification, not legal
> advice, and not a litigation guarantee.

Audits start at $199. Reports are HTML + PDF, written so a client's own
developer can act on them the same day. Automated testing (axe-core) catches
roughly half of WCAG issues; the Professional and Conformance tiers add human
keyboard-only and screen-reader review for the half that automation cannot
judge, and every report states plainly what a scan cannot check.

## Services

- [Starter Audit — $199](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): up to 10 key pages against WCAG 2.1 Level A/AA, severity-ranked HTML + PDF report, element-level fix guidance, widget gap check. 3 business days.
- [Professional Audit — $1,450](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): up to 25 pages, everything in Starter plus manual keyboard-navigation testing, screen-reader spot testing, and a prioritized remediation roadmap with effort estimates. 5 business days.
- [Conformance Package — $2,950](https://aaronsiebold.github.io/theaccessaudit/#pricing): up to 50 pages, everything in Professional plus VPAT 2.5Rev / ACR preparation for procurement, a post-remediation re-scan with delta report, and a findings walkthrough call. 7–10 business days.
- Remediation is quoted after the audit from the actual findings ($125/hr or a fixed package). Ongoing monitoring — monthly re-scan, diff and alert — is $149/mo.

## What we will not claim

- No website can be certified "ADA compliant" — there is no official certification, and no audit or overlay widget prevents a claim from being filed.
- Roughly a quarter of recent ADA web suits were filed against sites that already had an accessibility overlay installed. We do not build or sell overlays.
- Whether an audit satisfies a specific legal obligation is a question for the client's attorney.
